description: On a failed run, launch an agent asset selection with the failed run id on the launched run's tags, and announce it in Slack -- the thread stays open for slack_reply. Rate-limited per (job, error signature).

asset_keys.label: Asset Keys
asset_keys.description: Agent asset(s) to launch on a failure (e.g. a bug-fixer asset + its Slack-reply asset).

code_location_names.label: Code Location Names
code_location_names.description: Only trigger for runs from one of these code locations. Leave unset to monitor every code location.

job_names.label: Job Names
job_names.description: Only trigger for these job names. Leave unset to monitor every job.

required_tags.label: Required Tags
required_tags.description: Only trigger when the failed run carries ALL of these tags (key=value).

slack_channel.label: Slack Channel
slack_channel.description: Channel to announce a failed run in (either `C123ABC456` id or `#channel-name`).

slack_bot_token_env_var.label: Slack Bot Token Env Var
slack_bot_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the bot's `xoxb-...` token. Needs `chat:write`.

message_template.label: Message Template
message_template.description: Optional custom message template. Placeholders: {run_id} (short, 8 chars), {job_name}, {url}. Default: ':beetle: Run <{url}|{run_id}> of `{job_name}` failed. Looking into the cause.'

dagster_url.label: Dagster Url
dagster_url.description: Base Dagster(+) URL (e.g. 'https://org.dagster.cloud/prod') used to build the run link in the Slack message. Leave unset to link just the run id with no URL.

evidence_dir.label: Evidence Dir
evidence_dir.description: Directory the cooldown rate-limiter's small per-event files live under (local or NFS-shared path -- not a cloud URI; exclusive-create needs a real filesystem).

max_triage_per_hour.label: Max Triage Per Hour
max_triage_per_hour.description: Max failures triaged (Slack post + run launch) per (job, error signature) per rolling hour.

cooldown_minutes.label: Cooldown Minutes
cooldown_minutes.description: After triaging one occurrence of a (job, error signature), suppress further triage of the SAME signature for this many minutes.

skip_in_branch_deployments.label: Skip In Branch Deployments
skip_in_branch_deployments.description: Skip every tick while running inside a Dagster+ branch deployment (DAGSTER_CLOUD_IS_BRANCH_DEPLOYMENT=1). A branch deployment runs its own copy of every sensor alongside the full deployment's -- without this, a branch deployment double-announces the same failed run in Slack and double-launches a fixer run.

max_runs_per_day.label: Max Runs Per Day
max_runs_per_day.description: Max failures triaged GLOBALLY (across every signature) per rolling 24 hours -- an independent ceiling on top of max_triage_per_hour, for a deployment where many distinct failure signatures could each individually stay under the hourly cap but still add up to an unreasonable number of agent runs over a day. Leave unset for no daily cap.

cooldown_hours.label: Cooldown Hours
cooldown_hours.description: Same as cooldown_minutes, expressed in hours -- set this instead when the natural unit is days (e.g. 168 for a week of flapping). Takes precedence over cooldown_minutes when set.

use_retry_rule.label: Use Retry Rule
use_retry_rule.description: A failed run that is itself a retry of an earlier run (carries Dagster's own dagster/root_run_id tag) is skipped if that retry chain's root was already triaged; an untriaged retry becomes the triage point for its whole chain instead, so later retries of the same underlying failure are suppressed too. This is a direct lineage check (not signature matching), so it still works even with cooldown set to 0.

exclude_code_location_names.label: Exclude Code Location Names
exclude_code_location_names.description: Trigger for every code location EXCEPT these -- same naming convention as dagster_discovery_tools' own exclude_locations. The usual case is excluding the agents' own code location, so a fixer run's own failures don't trigger more fixer runs. Checked independently of code_location_names (an allow-list); set whichever shape fits -- an 'allow only these' list, or a 'watch everything except these' one.
